title: HTML, CSS amasung JavaScript makhoina makhoigi marakta karamna thougal touribage
learningObjectives: HTML-na Heading, Paragraph, Link, Image, Form amasung Button-gumba Content-gi meaning amasung structure thok-hanba matamda mahakki role khangba ngamgani; HTML masamakna pumnamakki Design nattraga Behaviour thok-hanbani haibasi khangba ngamgani.
CSS-na HTML Content adu karamna ujagani haibadu control tou-i—colour, Font, Text Size, Spacing, Border, Alignment amasung Responsive Layout yai haibadu khangba ngamgani.
JavaScript-na Page-da Behaviour amasung Logic hapchill-i; Click-ki response piriba, Form Input check touba, calculation touba, Message utpa amasung Content update touba haibadu khangba ngamgani.

HTML, CSS amasung JavaScript-ki marakta main responsibility khennaba adu compare touraga Content, Appearance nattraga Interaction change touba matamda karamba Technology sijinnagani haibadu khangba ngamgani.
Browser-na HTML Document paari, link touraba CSS amasung JavaScript Files khangdok-i, Page Structure sem-i, Styles apply tou-i amasung Scripts run tou-i haibadu explain touba ngamgani.
Small Project ama-da index.html, styles.css amasung app.js-ki role khangba ngamgani amasung HTML-gi link amasung script Elements-singi matung-inna Files page-da connect touba khangba ngamgani.
HTML Button-da click touba matam JavaScript Event Listener-na adu khangduna Page Text nattraga State change touba process adu explain touba ngamgani.
CSS Selectors-na HTML Elements khanghan-i amasung JavaScript-na DOM sijinnaduna Page Elements Select amasung Update touba ngamgani haibadu khangba ngamgani.
HTML-da Structure, CSS-da Presentation amasung JavaScript-da Interaction Logic thamduna clear File Names amasung correct Relative Paths sijinnaduna Project organize touba ngamgani.
Makhoina change ama ama tou, relevant File Save tou, Page Refresh nattraga Retest tou amasung expected result leitaba matamda problem adu karamba Technology-da leibage khangba ngamgani.
Stylesheet Link leitaba, Script Path wrong oiba, Selector match leitaba, JavaScript Syntax Error nattraga wrong Element-da Event Listener attach touba gumba common errors khangba ngamgani.
Technology marisinggi main responsibility khennaba oirabasu Browser-na makhoibu combine touraga Web Page experience ama sem-i haibadu explain touba ngamgani.

understand.concept: Modern Web Page ama semnaba HTML, CSS amasung JavaScript haiba main Technology marising asi makhoina makhoigi marakta thougal touri. HTML-na Page-gi Content amasung structure define tou-i—Heading, Paragraph, Link, Image, Form amasung Button-gumba. CSS-na Content adu karamna ujagani haibadu define tou-i—colour, Font, size, spacing, Border amasung Layout. JavaScript-na Page-da Behaviour hapchill-i—Button Click-ki response, Form check, calculation amasung Content update. Browser-na makhoibu pumnamak combine touraga Page ama oina utli.
understand.whyItMatters: Technology marising asi makhoigi role khanglabadi karamba Code adu karamba File-da yathang-gadage haibadu khangba yadaba ngamgani. Content amasung Structure HTML-da, Design CSS-da, Interaction JavaScript-da thamlabadi Project paiba, test touba, correct touba amasung expand touba kolay oigani. Role khennaba oirabasu makhoina makhoigi marakta relation leiri: CSS-na HTML Elements select tou-i amasung JavaScript-na DOM sijinnaduna Page change touba ngam-i.
understand.history: Lesson asi modern Web Development-gi practical concept amasung Technology-gi relation khangnaba semjare.
understand.analogy: Drama ama amuk khannou. HTML asi story, character amasung stage arrangement-gumba oiri—karisu leiriba amasung karamna arrangement touba haibadu define tou-i. CSS asi costume, light amasung stage decoration-gumba oiri—performance-gi appearance change tou-i. JavaScript asi stage-da thokliba action amasung signal-gumba oiri—event ama-gi response-da scene change touba ngam-i. Audience-na makhoibu pumnamak drama ama oina u-i.
understand.analogyLimit: Analogy asi main role khangduna thamnaba matamda matik leiriba tool ama ni. Real Web Page-da Technology marising asi makhoina makhoibu affect touba ngam-i. JavaScript-na Content nattraga CSS Class change touba ngam-i, CSS-na state matung-inna change touba ngam-i amasung HTML-gi meaning-na Accessibility amasung Browser behaviour affect tou-i.

explain.narrative:
Small Web Project ama-da masani oina connected Files marising leiri. `index.html`-da Page-gi Content amasung Structure leiri. HTML-gi `link` Element-na CSS File connect tou-i amasung `script` Element-na JavaScript File load tou-i. `styles.css`-da colour, spacing, size amasung Layout-gumba Presentation Rules leiri. `app.js`-da Button Click-gumba Events-ki response piba instructions leiri. JavaScript-na DOM sijinnaduna Page Element-gi Text nattraga Class change touba ngam-i.

Browser-na HTML File hangdokpa matamda Document paari, connected CSS amasung JavaScript Files khangdok-i, Page Structure sem-i, CSS Rules apply tou-i amasung JavaScript run tou-i. User-na Files ahum separate oina udrabasu, makhoigi combined result oina Page ama u-i.

Mamangda HTML-da necessary Structure sem-u, adugi matung CSS-da appearance improve tou-u amasung matung JavaScript-da Interaction hapchill-u. Change touba matam pumnamakta relevant File Save touraga Page test tou-u. Heading u-i adubu Style udrabadi Stylesheet Link amasung CSS Selector check tou-u. Button u-i adubu Click touba matam response leitadrabadi Script Path, Console Error amasung Event Listener check tou-u. Change ama ama touba matam problem-gi cause khangba kolay oigani.

examples.code:
Welcome

/* styles.css */ body { font-family: sans-serif; } button { padding: 8px 12px; } // app.js const button = document.querySelector("#messageButton"); button.addEventListener("click", () => { document.querySelector("#title").textContent = "Hello from JavaScript!"; });
examples.explanation: HTML-na Heading amasung Button create tou-i amasung CSS amasung JavaScript Files adu Page-ga connect tou-i. CSS-na Button-gi Padding define tou-i. JavaScript-na Click Event listen tou-i amasung DOM sijinnaduna Heading Text change tou-i. Browser-na makhoigi result pumnamak Interactive Page ama oina utli. Real Project-da Code part pumnamak mahakki own File-da tham-u.
examples.expectedOutput: Browser-da Heading amasung Button u-i. Button Click touba matam Heading Text change tou-i.

practise.guidedTask: Project Folder ama create touraga `index.html`, `styles.css` amasung `app.js` Files sem-u. HTML-da Heading amasung Button hapchill-u. CSS-da colour nattraga Spacing change tou-u. JavaScript-da Click Event hapchillaga Heading Text change tou-u. Files pumnamak Save touraga Browser-da Page hangduna Button test tou-u.
practise.independentTask: Nangna pamliba subject ama-da small introduction Page ama sem-u. Heading, Paragraph amasung Button tham-u. Content HTML-da, Design CSS-da amasung interaction ama JavaScript-da tham-u. Matungda part khudingmak karamba File-da leibage amasung Button Click touba matam karisu thok-i haibadu explain tou-u.
hints: `link` Element-gi Stylesheet Path asi actual File Name amasung Folder-ga match tou-i haibra check tou-u.
Script Path correct oibra check tou-u; `defer`-na HTML Parse touba matung JavaScript run tou-i.
CSS Selector-gi id nattraga class name adu HTML Element-ga exact match oigadabani.
JavaScript Errors utnaba Browser Developer Tools-gi Console hang-u.
Change ama ama tou, Save tou amasung Page test tou-u.
